clusters.headline: FSSAI Expands Water Checks Following Bisleri Unsafe Sample Finding
aiSummaryBullets: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) is initiating nationwide tests across all packaged water brands.
The move follows legal action against Bisleri International regarding a single water sample from a September 2025 batch that allegedly exceeded bromate limits.

clusters.headline: PM Modi And Nepal Prime Minister Hold Bilateral Talks In New Delhi
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Nepal Prime Minister held formal bilateral discussions regarding energy, trade, and connectivity.
The leaders participated in a cultural gift exchange featuring items including Ganges water, sandalwood, and sacred rudraksh beads.

clusters.headline: Prime Minister Modi Holds Bilateral Talks With Nepal PM Balen Shah
aiSummaryBullets: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah is on his first official state visit to India to engage in bilateral discussions with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The leaders are focusing on strengthening ties through agreements related to energy, infrastructure, technology, and trade connectivity.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Intervenes In Tamil Nadu Karthigai Deepam Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India is reviewing a plea regarding the Karthigai Deepam lighting ceremony at Tirupparankundram hill.
The legal challenge has prompted political friction in Tamil Nadu, with the Bharatiya Janata Party criticizing the state government's stance.

clusters.headline: Defence Ministry Finalizes INS Betwa Propulsion Refit Contract
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian Defence Ministry has signed a formal contract valued at ₹498 crore.
The agreement focuses on the propulsion refit of the naval frigate INS Betwa.

clusters.headline: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Proposes Name Change To Paschim Banga
aiSummaryBullets: Chief Minister Suvendu intends to table a proposal to rename West Bengal to Paschim Banga on December 9.
The Bharatiya Janata Party-led government seeks to align the English state name with its existing Bengali designation.

clusters.headline: Congress And Samajwadi Party Begin Seat-Sharing Talks In Uttar Pradesh
aiSummaryBullets: Congress and Samajwadi Party leaders met to discuss a potential seat-sharing arrangement for the Uttar Pradesh assembly polls.
The ongoing negotiations involve four designated representatives from each of the two political parties.

clusters.headline: India And Nepal Launch New Ayodhya To Janakpur Railway Service
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Modi and officials inaugurated the Saryu-Kamala Express connecting Ayodhya Cantt and Janakpur Dham.
The new cross-border railway operates on a weekly schedule featuring ten designated stations along the route.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Rejects Separate Hearing Plea on Election Law Verdict
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India denied a request for a separate listing to recall a split verdict on election commissioner appointments.
The court chose not to grant an urgent, independent hearing for the petition regarding the previous split decision.

clusters.headline: Kerala High Court Overturns Suspensions At Sanskrit University
aiSummaryBullets: The Kerala High Court invalidated the suspension orders and inquiry reports issued against students at the Sree Sankaracharya University of Sanskrit.
Student protesters argued that they were suspended without receiving reasons or a fair opportunity to defend themselves during the inquiry process.

clusters.headline: Woman Arrested For Murder Of Three-Year-Old In Bulandshahr
aiSummaryBullets: A three-year-old child went missing from her home in Bhud, Bulandshahr, on Saturday morning.
A woman was apprehended by authorities in connection with the child's death.

clusters.headline: Gold Sinks To One-Year Low As Market Prices Experience Volatility
aiSummaryBullets: Gold prices have fallen to their lowest level in the past year.
Silver has also experienced a notable decline, dropping by 2.46 lakh rupees from its peak.

clusters.headline: BJP Criticizes Rahul Gandhi Over Recent Comments and Social Media Posts
aiSummaryBullets: BJP leaders have criticized Rahul Gandhi for his recent social media post depicting an Ardhanareshwar image, which he used to target the party.
The BJP has also condemned comments made by Rahul Gandhi regarding India's economy and his purported avoidance of parliamentary debates.

clusters.headline: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik Joins SCO Forum Amid Delhi Tensions
aiSummaryBullets: Pakistan Minister Musadik Malik attended the SCO Civilisational Dialogue in New Delhi, sparking political debate in India.
The forum concluded with the adoption of an outcome document highlighting the role of shared history and cultural exchange among SCO members.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Records Poor Levels Amid Pollution Control Plans
aiSummaryBullets: Delhi's air quality has reached a poor level with an air quality index of 249.
The Commission for Air Quality Management is currently assessing pollution control strategies.

clusters.headline: US Report Links China Support For Pakistan To Operation Sindoor
aiSummaryBullets: A recent US congressional report claims China provided critical military and economic aid to Pakistan during Operation Sindoor.
The analysis suggests Beijing utilized these tactics to deliberately counteract India’s strategic and economic advancement in the region.

clusters.headline: TVK MLA V.S. Babu, Who Defeated M.K. Stalin, Has Passed Away
aiSummaryBullets: TVK legislator V.S. Babu has died following a 71-day period of medical treatment.
Babu previously gained political recognition for winning the Kolathur assembly constituency over M.K. Stalin.

clusters.headline: RJD Workers Protest Following PM Modi's Nitish Setu Inauguration
aiSummaryBullets: Supporters of the Rashtriya Janata Dal removed and damaged promotional banners of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar.
Protesters stated they were demonstrating against the exclusion of party leader Tejashwi Yadav from the inauguration event of the Nitish Setu.

clusters.headline: Bengal BJP MLA Rekha Patra Hospitalized Following Health Emergency
aiSummaryBullets: Bengal BJP legislator Rekha Patra has been admitted to the hospital for urgent medical care.
While family members have suggested food poisoning, the party is addressing reports regarding potential pesticide ingestion.

clusters.headline: Cyclone Akvan Weakens Into Depression As Heavy Rains Hit Odisha
aiSummaryBullets: Cyclone Akvan has dissipated into a depression, though lingering weather systems continue to bring heavy rainfall to parts of Odisha and West Bengal.
Local administrations in Andhra Pradesh are managing water release from reservoirs following flooding in districts including Srikakulam.
